Description: An in-situ Minor Rock Edict carved into quartzite detailing Ashoka's Dhamma teachings. Citations: Upinder Singh (2006), 'Delhi: Ancient History to the Present'; Romila Thapar (1961), 'Asoka and the Decline of the Mauryas'.
Monolithic sandstone pillar brought from Topra in 1356 CE by Feroz Shah Tughlaq. Citations: Shams-i Siraj 'Afif, 'Tarikh-i-Firoz Shahi'; Upinder Singh (2006), 'Delhi: Ancient History to the Present'.
